subset_description: Published seven-day station CDD worked example, plus separately labelled synthetic HDD/CDD/EDD specification cases. Not station observations or a national energy-demand product.
citation: NOAA CPC, Explanation of the weekly and monthly degree day data summaries, section 1 (Station data), retrieved 2026-10-17.
license: NOAA/NWS public-domain information unless otherwise noted; no exception is marked for the section-1 numbers. Attribute NOAA/NWS/CPC; no endorsement implied. https://www.weather.gov/disclaimer
notes: Manually transcribed the seven daily mean Fahrenheit temperatures, seven CDD values, base 65 F, total 32 F day and section-1 excerpt from the live CPC page. HTML character entities normalized to Unicode in the excerpt; raw retrieved page SHA-256 is in reference.json. Inputs convert as (F-32)*5/9; degree-day differences convert as F_day*5/9 without offset. No temperature rounding. Integer source values are exact; atol=1e-12 C day permits conversion roundoff only. Heating and EDD synthetic cases, distinct bases, and NaN propagation are specification evidence, not published numerical oracles. EDD=HDD+CDD describes climate-driven demand, not actual load. No implementation-generated outputs or C3S values; no measured implementation agreement until #1164. Maintainer confirmation of transcription/extraction is required in the fixture PR.
